question: Calculates the percentage of new users who, between August 1, 2016, and April 30, 2017, both stayed on the site for more than 5 minutes during their initial visit and made a purchase on a subsequent visit at any later time, relative to the total number of new users in the same period.
sql:
WITH new_users AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND totals.newVisits = 1
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
initial_visits AS (
  SELECT 
    s.fullVisitorId,
    s.totals.timeOnSite
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  JOIN new_users n ON s.fullVisitorId = n.fullVisitorId
  WHERE s._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170430'
    AND s.visitNumber = 1
    AND s.totals.newVisits = 1
),
users_with_subsequent_purchase AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
  JOIN new_users n ON s.fullVisitorId = n.fullVisitorId
  WHERE s.visitNumber > 1
    AND s.totals.transactions > 0
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN iv.timeOnSite > 300 AND usp.fullVisitorId IS NOT NULL THEN n.fullVisitorId END),
      COUNT(DISTINCT n.fullVisitorId)
    ) * 100,
    2
  ) as percentage
FROM new_users n
LEFT JOIN initial_visits iv ON n.fullVisitorId = iv.fullVisitorId
LEFT JOIN users_with_subsequent_purchase usp ON n.fullVisitorId = usp.fullVisitorId
